BJP MP Nishikant Dubey has raised fresh questions about Sonia Gandhi's alleged association with Maruti Technical Services Private Limited. In the 250th episode of his series 'Congress's Dark Chapter', Dubey made several claims about Sonia Gandhi's alleged 50% stake in the company, land allocation, government support, bank loans and the role of the Indira Gandhi government in the Maruti project. Here's what he alleged and why the issue has resurfaced.
